title: Gemini Notebook Launches Website Generation Feature, Supports Creating Interactive Webpages in One Sentence
excerpt: Gemini Notebook has launched a website generation feature, allowing users to quickly turn existing resources into interactive, shareable websites through natura
content_html:
Gemini Notebook has launched a website generation feature, allowing users to quickly turn existing resources into interactive, shareable websites through natural language instructions.

According to the latest tweet from user @Gemini_Notebook, users only need to type "build me a website" in the chat box and describe specific requirements, such as an interactive dashboard or a project tracker, and the system will automatically generate the corresponding webpage. After generation, users can open it directly in a new tab or share the website with others.

This feature is available to all users aged 18 and above worldwide and can be accessed through the web without complex development work. The official team also invites users to share real-world use cases.

This update further expands Gemini Notebook's content application capabilities, extending it from an information organization and knowledge processing tool to lightweight website generation scenarios. Lowering the barrier to web development through natural language interaction also reflects how AI products are moving from content generation toward interactive, deliverable application building.
